results.title: Vadzo Imaging Introduces Bolt-2020BRS: 20MP AR2020 Raw Bayer MIPI Camera for AI Inspection, OCR, and Embedded Vision
results.description: Vadzo's Bolt-2020BRS is a 20MP AR2020 Raw Bayer MIPI Camera built on the onsemi HyperLux LP AR2020 sensor, streaming unprocessed 8-bit Bayer data over 4-lane MIPI CSI-2 with sub-10ms latency for AI inspection, OCR, and embedded vision platforms needing direct sensor access for custom ISP pipelines on SoC accelerators, FPGAs, and edge AI platforms. As a board-level AR2020 Bayer MIPI Camera with 100dB HDR and NIR response at 850nm and 940nm, it gives OEM teams full control over image processing
